Muso ŋana , Afiriki tilebinyanfan n' a cɛmancɛ yanfan ani Magɛrɛbu fana y' u bolo don min kɔrɔ , lagosira , k' a tɔgɔ tiɲɛ ani k' a lanɔgɔ a yɛrɛ fasoden ɲɔgɔnw kɛ , k' a kɔrɔ kɛ ko dɔw dusu tun bɛna kasi ni nin ɲɔgɔnna tɔgɔsɔrɔ ye Afirini kunna .
